takeaway: The Domain Name System (DNS) is the internet's invisible address book. It translates website names into numeric IP addresses, making the internet we know possible to navigate!
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Ever wonder how your browser finds ANY website from just a simple name? There's an incredible, hidden system making it all happen!

Here’s the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 Every time you type a website name, a silent hero called the Domain Name System (DNS) kicks in.
🔹 DNS translates that easy-to-remember name (like youtube.com) into a unique numeric IP address (like 172.217.160.142) that computers need to find the exact server.
🔹 Without this invisible, constantly updated address book, you'd have to remember complex number sequences for every site, making the internet impossible to use!
